name: Rock Elemental Shard
summary: Rock Elemental Shards are fragments gathered from rock elementals in the Badlands. Jarkal Mossmeld needs them among several reagents to replenish his alchemical stocks.

sections.title: Stone Reagents
sections.body: In Kargath, Jarkal Mossmeld asks for five Rock Elemental Shards alongside buzzard gizzards and crag coyote fangs. He is an alchemist seeking to replenish his stocks, and promises coin for the gathered reagents.

faq.q: What are Rock Elemental Shards for?
faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath needs five Rock Elemental Shards to replenish his alchemical stocks.

faq.q: Where do Rock Elemental Shards come from?
faq.answer: Rock Elemental Shards come from rock elementals in the Badlands.
Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist in Kargath, asks for five Rock Elemental Shards.
Jarkal also asks for five buzzard gizzards and ten crag coyote fangs.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can bring the Badlands reagents to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, where he offers coin for them.
